description: This file defines a PHP interface 'CollectionEndpoint' within the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifying methods for handling collection-based API endpoints such as retrieving, creating, and deleting resources. It includes method signatures and their associated documentation, along with references to external exception and serializer classes.

classes.name: CollectionEndpoint
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for collection-based API endpoints, including methods for retrieving, creating, deleting resources and obtaining validation rules.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of resources, with potential exceptions related to normalization, unimplemented features, record not found, or forbidden access.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method; may throw NotImplementedException.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new resource, with potential exceptions similar to 'getAll'.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'create' method; may throw NotImplementedException.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a list of resources, with potential exceptions similar to 'getAll'.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'delete' method; may throw NotImplementedException.
